title: The Fund That Blew Up 67% in a Month Is Back, With a Twist
speaker: tastylive Signal vs. Noise host

macro_themes.view: Warm September CPI supports the idea that the energy shock is spreading into the broader economy after ~6 months.
CXMT pulling forward DRAM production threatens the memory-scarcity thesis behind AI infrastructure names.

notes: Story about Leopold Aschenbrenner's fund re-entering AI infra (AMD, BE, CRWV, SK Hynix, SNDK, MU) via calls; host gives no directional bias, only that a July-style forced liquidation is unlikely. Host mentions own Bloom Energy exposure.
